QuestInfo.name: [Twilight Perion] The Second Future
QuestInfo.0: The Maple World conference is taking place. Listen to #bAthena Pierce#k.
QuestInfo.1:
A conference to tackle a problem plaguing Maple World is taking place. What could be on the itinerary? Head to the #bConference Room of the Alliance#k.

#e#bYou can enter the Conference Room of the Alliance through the Dimensional Mirror in town.
QuestInfo.2: The conference concerns the nightmare people have been experiencing. In the nightmare, the people of Maple World see the events that took place in the Gate to the Future.
